<thought>The spectrum shows a typical carbon isotopic envelope (M+1 ≈9 % and M+2 ≈0.6 % of the base peak), which is consistent with ~8–9 carbons. No characteristic M+2 peak of chlorine, bromine, or sulfur is present, so only carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
